remarks: Stunning 2 Bedroom, 2 Full Bathroom condo situated in a premier downtown location. This chic and sophisticated historic building offers boutique living with ONLY 7 loft-style units. Gorgeous exposed brick, weathered character white oak floors, high ceilings with recessed lighting and wall to wall Pella windows flood the unit with natural light. Fully renovated with no expense spared, the unit features an in-unit GE washer/dryer, Samsung stainless steel appliances, Caesarstone countertops, and Moen kitchen and bath fixtures. The building features an elevator, secured lobby with interior mailboxes, and tenant parking is available at the nearby Bell St garage for an additional fee. Experience NYC vibes with the ease and convenience of Downtown Stamford! THIS IS THE PLACE TO BE with the area's best dining, shopping and MetroNorth just steps away!
